name: image-editing
description: Inspect food photographs, find rights-appropriate real-object references, and direct OpenAI image-editing tools with preservation-first prompts and visual review.

interface.shortDescription: Prompt and review OpenAI food-image edits.
interface.longDescription: Visually inspects and curates food photographs, decomposes scenes into semantic object roles, finds provenance-verified and rights-appropriate real-object references online, converts the requested outcome into preservation-first prompts for OpenAI image-editing tools, and reviews complete outputs for food, geometry, and object-integration drift. The plugin contains no image-processing, segmentation, scraping, or compositing program.
defaultPrompt: Write a preservation-first OpenAI edit prompt for this food photo.
Find an appropriate real-object reference and integrate it into this image.
Edit this food image and review the result for drift.
